title: Add local model availability probes
summary: Add explicit local model availability probes so opt-in Ollama live tests report missing models clearly before expanding model coverage.
expectedFailureModes: Live Ollama tests fail with generic connection or model errors that look like code regressions.

nextAction: Add a model availability probe command or script plus docs linking it from live coverage.
